source_artifacts.name: Leica_M11P_Standard_v04_COLOR_LOCKED_sRGB_33.cube
source_artifacts.role: baseline colour-locked LUT with no added Leica tone

source_artifacts.name: Leica_M11P_Standard_v04_TONE20_sRGB_33.cube
source_artifacts.role: 20% blend toward recovered firmware Standard Q12 tone response

source_artifacts.name: Leica_M11P_Standard_v04_TONE35_sRGB_33.cube
source_artifacts.role: 35% blend toward recovered firmware Standard Q12 tone response

provenance_note: The original cube headers explicitly describe TONE20/TONE35 as 20%/35% blends toward the recovered firmware Standard Q12 tone response and describe COLOR_LOCKED as having no added Leica tone. These cubes are therefore retained only as a derivative cross-check/recovery path while exact firmware assets are unavailable; they do not define the project architecture.
axis: first 33 LUT entries, corresponding to the pure-red input axis in .cube ordering used by the generator
working_recovery_equation: full_tone_output = baseline + (blended_output - baseline) / blend_fraction; gain = full_tone_output / baseline
candidate_coordinate_status: inferred_from_recorded_tone-luma weights and luminance-preserving scaling; generator semantics still require independent verification
clipping_rule_for_recovery: exclude baseline<=0 and any sample where TONE20 or TONE35 is clipped at/near 1.0; use agreement between independently reconstructed 20% and 35% gains as a validity check
